item.truedeltatale.rude_buster.tooltip: A heavy slash. Big damage and knockback.
item.truedeltatale.fireshock.tooltip: A bolt of fire that sets the target alight.
item.truedeltatale.iceshock.tooltip: Freezes the target. Enemies it defeats shatter.
item.truedeltatale.snowgrave.tooltip: A blizzard where you aim. Craft with any magic item to make Firegrave.
item.truedeltatale.thunder_buster.toolti: Rude Buster and Fireshock fused. Calls down lightning.
item.truedeltatale.firegrave.tooltip: Snowgrave turned inside out. A firestorm where you aim.
item.truedeltatale.knights_swoon.tooltip: Dash forward and stun everything ahead. 5 uses; repair in an anvil with another magic item.
message.truedeltatale.spent: The Knight's Swoon is spent. Repair it in an anvil with another magic item.
